limitations: Review is a complete row census with mechanistic pooling and all-corpus retrieval support; it is not manual inspection of every one of the 997578 possible row pairs.
No second independent reviewer or model pretraining provenance is available. Public benchmark exposure cannot be ruled out.
Mechanism taxonomy is judgmental. Report source-level and cross-family stress groupings as sensitivity, not new independent observations.
Exclusions and regrouping may empty family/split cells. Do not refill from previously exposed rows or claim a powered five-family test.
No model performance outcomes informed review. No provider calls or native tau2 adapter were added.
Full semantic correctness of all source answer keys and every possible code input is not certified by this independence review.
source_stress_interpretation: Extreme sensitivity with all test rows from the same source pooled. Not an estimate of effective sample size or a claim of perfect dependence.
